description: Source file for the ViewConvertLead class, which handles the lead conversion process within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for displaying the lead conversion form, processing form submissions, copying data between entities, managing relationships, and handling related activities.

classes.name: ViewConvertLead
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering the lead conversion view, handling the conversion logic, managing related entities, activities, validation, and rendering templates within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewConvertLead object, setting the metadata file path.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks user permissions before displaying the view; denies access if insufficient.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to render the lead conversion page, handle save requests, load definitions, prepare data, assign variables to templates, and display the conversion form.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the lead record based on the provided ID.

methods.name: loadDefs
methods.description: Loads the view definitions from the specified metadata file.

methods.name: getValidationJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation and toggling of form fields.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes the form submission, creates or links related beans (contacts, accounts, etc.), copies data, manages relationships, and marks the lead as converted.

methods.name: setMeetingsUsersRelationship
methods.description: Associates the current user with a meeting record during lead conversion.

methods.name: displaySaveResults
methods.description: Outputs a summary of the newly created or linked beans after conversion.

methods.name: handleActivities
methods.description: Transfers activities from the lead to related entities based on configuration.

methods.name: moveActivity
methods.description: Changes the parent relationship of an activity to a new bean.

methods.name: getActivitiesFromLead
methods.description: Fetches activities associated with the lead, including calls, tasks, meetings, emails, and notes.

methods.name: copyActivityAndRelateToBean
methods.description: Duplicates an activity and relates it to a specified bean, copying related information.

methods.name: populateNewBean
methods.description: Populates a new bean with data from the lead and contact, establishing necessary relationships.

methods.name: copyAddressFields
methods.description: Copies address information from a contact to a bean if address fields are empty.

methods.name: findRelationship
methods.description: Finds the name of the relationship link between two entities.

methods.name: findRelationshipByName
methods.description: Finds the relationship link name on a from entity given a relationship name.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for the module title display, including a link to the lead record.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks if the lead has already been converted and suggests duplicate contacts.
